rules: Credit every third-party asset and every AI tool.
NASA media is generally not copyrighted, but credit NASA as the source, do not claim it as your own, and do not imply NASA endorses the project.
Do not use the NASA logo, insignia or logotype. Write 'NASA data' as plain text.
Media with identifiable people can need extra care. Check the image page.
Pinterest is for ideas only. Do not use Pinterest images in the final video.
Samples 1 and 2 are drawn by the team, not taken from NASA.
Every real number in the game data files points to a NASA page in sources.json. Values without a source id are tagged designed or derived and must not be presented as NASA data.
